notes: Minimal in-repo gold queries for encode/decode and scope-menu tests. Not a Spider corpus pin. Host census data is optional external evidence only. T8 adds WHERE/GROUP/HAVING/ORDER/LIMIT coverage.

queries.sql: SELECT customers.name, orders.amount FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id

queries.notes: Star is structural, not a menu-indexable column name.

queries.sql: SELECT customers.name, products.title, orders.amount FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id JOIN products ON products.product_id = orders.product_id
SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Springfield'
queries.notes: T8 M2: WHERE equality with string literal.

queries.sql: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE customer_id > 0 AND city = 'Springfield' OR city = 'Shelbyville'
queries.notes: T8 M2: comparisons, AND/OR, integer and string literals. Canonical OR-lowest binding.

queries.sql: SELECT customers.name, orders.amount FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id WHERE orders.amount >= 100
queries.notes: T8 M2: JOIN + WHERE comparison on scope column.

queries.sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY city ASC LIMIT 5
queries.notes: T8 M3: GROUP BY / ORDER BY / LIMIT (u8 band).

queries.sql: SELECT city FROM customers WHERE customer_id > 0 GROUP BY city HAVING city = 'Springfield' ORDER BY city DESC LIMIT 10
queries.notes: T8 M3: full optional-clause ladder without aggregation (agg is T9).
T9 M4: COUNT(*) is structural — zero column menu tokens.
T9 M4: SUM(column) emits one column menu token.
T9 M4: DISTINCT marker is structural.

queries.sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM orders LIMIT 1)
queries.notes: T9 M5: uncorrelated scalar subquery opens inner scope root.
